claims.evidence: Tool output T0B4 shows the original caret.py code 'return v >= base and v[1] == base[1]' and T0B5 shows test_minor_bump failing for satisfies('1.5.0','^1.2.3').
The rules are stated in the new code docstring (T0B8), but no tool output verifies the ^0.0.3 behaviour; only satisfies calls for ^1.2.3 and ^0.2.3 were run in T0B11.

claims.evidence: The code implements this (T0B6), but no tool output tests numeric-vs-alphanumeric comparison within pre-release identifiers beyond the single '1.0.0-1' case; the semver spec was not consulted.
